     9	/-- One rounded componentwise product before tree reduction. -/
    10	def roundedProductTerm (model : Model) (x y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
    11	  model.mul x y
    12	
    13	/-- Exact componentwise products stored in the leaves of the reduction tree. -/
    14	def exactProductTree (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ)) : Tree ℝ :=
    15	  tree.map fun pair => pair.1 * pair.2
    16	
    17	/-- Rounded componentwise products stored in the same reduction shape. -/
    18	def roundedProductTree (model : Model) (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ)) : Tree ℝ :=
    19	  tree.map fun pair => roundedProductTerm model pair.1 pair.2
    20	
    21	/-- Compute a dot product by rounding every product and then reducing those
    22	products with rounded binary-tree addition. -/
    23	def roundedDotProduct (model : Model) (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ)) : ℝ :=
    24	  roundedSum model (roundedProductTree model tree)
    25	
    26	/-- Rounding each componentwise product perturbs its exact value by at most
    27	one unit roundoff. -/
    28	theorem roundedProductTree_isPerturbation (model : Model)
    29	    (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    30	    IsPerturbation model.u (exactProductTree tree) (roundedProductTree model tree) := by
    31	  induction tree with
    32	  | leaf pair =>
    33	      rcases pair with ⟨x, y⟩
    34	      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hround⟩ := model.round_spec (x * y)
    35	      apply IsPerturbation.leaf
    36	      simp only [roundedProductTerm, Model.mul]
    37	      rw [hround]
    38	      calc
    39	        |x * y * (1 + δ) - x * y| = |δ| * |x * y| := by
    40	          rw [show x * y * (1 + δ) - x * y = δ * (x * y) by ring, abs_mul]
    41	        _ ≤ model.u * |x * y| :=
    42	          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hδ (abs_nonneg (x * y))
    43	  | node left right ihLeft ihRight =>
    44	      exact IsPerturbation.node ihLeft ihRight
    45	
    46	/-- Deterministic backward-error theorem for a tree-based floating-point dot
    47	product. One error comes from multiplication and at most `tree.depth` errors
    48	come from the additions on a leaf-to-root path. -/
    49	theorem roundedDotProduct_exists_perturbation
    50	    (model : Model) (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ))
    51	    (hsmall : ((tree.depth + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * model.u < 1) :
    52	    ∃ perturbed : Tree ℝ,
    53	      IsPerturbation (gamma (tree.depth + 1) model.u)
    54	        (exactProductTree tree) perturbed ∧
    55	      perturbed.exactSum = roundedDotProduct model tree := by
    56	  have htail_small : (tree.depth : ℝ) * model.u < 1 := by
    57	    norm_num at hsmall ⊢
    58	    nlinarith [model.u_nonneg]
    59	  obtain ⟨perturbed, hsum, hvalue⟩ :=
    60	    roundedSum_exists_perturbation_of_depth_le model tree.depth
    61	      (roundedProductTree model tree) (by simp [roundedProductTree]) htail_small
    62	  have hproducts := roundedProductTree_isPerturbation model tree
    63	  have hcomposed :
    64	      IsPerturbation
    65	        (model.u + gamma tree.depth model.u * (1 + model.u))
    66	        (exactProductTree tree) perturbed :=
    67	    hproducts.trans hsum
    68	      (gamma_nonneg tree.depth model.u model.u_nonneg htail_small)
    69	  have hbound :
    70	      model.u + gamma tree.depth model.u * (1 + model.u) ≤
    71	        gamma (tree.depth + 1) model.u := by
    72	    have hstep := gamma_step tree.depth model.u model.u_nonneg hsmall
    73	    nlinarith
    74	  exact ⟨perturbed, hcomposed.mono hbound, hvalue⟩
    75

     3	/-! # Algorithm 1: offset-paired parallel binary-tree reduction -/
     4	
     5	namespace Research.BinaryTreeReduction
     6	
     7	/-- Pair corresponding trees from two halves. If the left half has an
     8	unmatched final tree, carry it forward unchanged. -/
     9	def combineHalves : List (Tree α) → List (Tree α) → List (Tree α)
    10	  | left, [] => left
    11	  | [], right => right
    12	  | left :: lefts, right :: rights =>
    13	      .node left right :: combineHalves lefts rights
    14	
    15	/-- One level of Algorithm 1. The split point is `⌈n/2⌉ = (n+1)/2`, so
    16	the first active partial sum is paired with the first partial sum in the
    17	second half. -/
    18	def reductionRound (forest : List (Tree α)) : List (Tree α) :=
    19	  let half := (forest.length + 1) / 2
    20	  combineHalves (forest.take half) (forest.drop half)
    21	
    22	/-- Record the initial forest and then `rounds` successive reduction levels. -/
    23	def reductionLevelsFromForest : ℕ → List (Tree α) → List (List (Tree α))
    24	  | 0, forest => [forest]
    25	  | rounds + 1, forest =>
    26	      forest :: reductionLevelsFromForest rounds (reductionRound forest)
    27	
    28	/-- Apply exactly `rounds` levels of Algorithm 1. -/
    29	def runRounds : ℕ → List (Tree α) → List (Tree α)
    30	  | 0, forest => forest
    31	  | rounds + 1, forest => runRounds rounds (reductionRound forest)
    32	
    33	/-- Algorithm 1 levels for a list of inputs. -/
    34	def reductionLevels (inputs : List α) : List (List (Tree α)) :=
    35	  reductionLevelsFromForest (Nat.clog 2 inputs.length) (inputs.map .leaf)
    36	
    37	/-- Read the exact partial sums at every recorded level. -/
    38	def exactLevelValues (levels : List (List (Tree ℝ))) : List (List ℝ) :=
    39	  levels.map fun forest => forest.map Tree.exactSum
    40	
    41	/-- The numerical length recurrence induced by one reduction round. -/
    42	def roundLengthAfter : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ
    43	  | 0, n => n
    44	  | rounds + 1, n => roundLengthAfter rounds ((n + 1) / 2)
    45	
    46	/-- All leaves in a tree, with multiplicity but without imposing an order. -/
    47	def Tree.leafMultiset : Tree α → Multiset α
    48	  | .leaf value => {value}
    49	  | .node left right => left.leafMultiset + right.leafMultiset

    51	theorem Tree.exactSum_eq_leafMultiset_sum (tree : Tree ℝ) :
    52	    tree.exactSum = tree.leafMultiset.sum := by
    53	  induction tree with
    54	  | leaf value => simp [Tree.exactSum, Tree.leafMultiset]
    55	  | node left right ihLeft ihRight =>
    56	      simp [Tree.exactSum, Tree.leafMultiset, ihLeft, ihRight]
    57	
    58	/-- All leaves in a forest, counted with multiplicity. -/
    59	def forestLeafMultiset (forest : List (Tree α)) : Multiset α :=
    60	  (forest.map Tree.leafMultiset).sum

    72	    (reductionRound forest).length = (forest.length + 1) / 2 := by
    73	  simp only [reductionRound, combineHalves_length, List.length_take,

    78	    (h : forest ≠ []) : reductionRound forest ≠ [] := by
    79	  cases forest with

    81	  | cons tree trees =>
    82	      intro hempty

    94	theorem runRounds_length (rounds : ℕ) (forest : List (Tree α)) :
    95	    (runRounds rounds forest).length = roundLengthAfter rounds forest.length := by
    96	  induction rounds generalizing forest with
    97	  | zero => rfl
    98	  | succ rounds ih =>

   101	/-- Repeated ceiling-halving of a positive number reaches one after its
   102	base-two ceiling logarithm number of rounds. -/
   103	theorem roundLengthAfter_clog_two (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
   104	    roundLengthAfter (Nat.clog 2 n) n = 1 := by
   105	  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
   106	  | h n ih =>
   107	      by_cases hn_one : n ≤ 1
   108	      · have hn_eq : n = 1 := by omega
   109	        subst n
   110	        simp [roundLengthAfter]
   111	      · have hn_two : 2 ≤ n := by omega
   112	        let next := (n + 1) / 2
   113	        have hnext_pos : 0 < next := by
   114	          dsimp [next]
   115	          omega
   116	        have hnext_lt : next < n := by
   117	          dsimp [next]
   118	          omega
   119	        have hclog : Nat.clog 2 n = Nat.clog 2 next + 1 := by
   120	          rw [Nat.clog_of_two_le (by decide) hn_two]
   121	          congr 2
   122	        rw [hclog]
   123	        simp only [roundLengthAfter]
   124	        exact ih next hnext_lt hnext_pos

   127	def finalForest (inputs : List α) : List (Tree α) :=

   129	
   130	theorem finalForest_length {inputs : List α} (h : inputs ≠ []) :
   131	    (finalForest inputs).length = 1 := by
   132	  rw [finalForest, runRounds_length, List.length_map]
   133	  apply roundLengthAfter_clog_two
   134	  cases inputs with
   135	  | nil => exact (h rfl).elim

   144	@[simp] theorem forestLeafMultiset_append
   145	    (left right : List (Tree α)) :
   146	    forestLeafMultiset (left ++ right) =

   148	  simp [forestLeafMultiset]

   151	    (left right : List (Tree α)) :
   152	    forestLeafMultiset (combineHalves left right) =
   153	      forestLeafMultiset left + forestLeafMultiset right := by
   154	  induction left generalizing right with
   155	  | nil => cases right <;> simp [combineHalves, forestLeafMultiset]
   156	  | cons tree trees ih =>
   157	      cases right with
   158	      | nil => simp [combineHalves, forestLeafMultiset]
   159	      | cons other others =>
   160	          simp only [combineHalves, forestLeafMultiset, List.map_cons,

   162	          have hih := ih others
   163	          unfold forestLeafMultiset at hih
   164	          rw [hih]
   165	          simp only [add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm]

   167	/-- A reduction round neither loses nor duplicates an input leaf. -/
   168	theorem forestLeafMultiset_reductionRound (forest : List (Tree α)) :
   169	    forestLeafMultiset (reductionRound forest) = forestLeafMultiset forest := by
   170	  rw [reductionRound]
   171	  rw [forestLeafMultiset_combineHalves]
   172	  rw [← forestLeafMultiset_append]

   175	theorem forestLeafMultiset_runRounds (rounds : ℕ)
   176	    (forest : List (Tree α)) :
   177	    forestLeafMultiset (runRounds rounds forest) =
   178	      forestLeafMultiset forest := by
   179	  induction rounds generalizing forest with
   180	  | zero => rfl
   181	  | succ rounds ih =>
   182	      simp only [runRounds]
   183	      rw [ih, forestLeafMultiset_reductionRound]
   184	
   185	/-- Every input appears once in the initial leaf forest. -/
   186	@[simp] theorem forestLeafMultiset_map_leaf (inputs : List α) :
   187	    forestLeafMultiset (inputs.map Tree.leaf) = inputs := by
   188	  induction inputs with
   189	  | nil => simp [forestLeafMultiset]
   190	  | cons value values ih =>
   191	      change {value} + forestLeafMultiset (values.map Tree.leaf) =
   192	        (value :: values : Multiset α)
   193	      rw [ih]
   194	      rfl

   196	/-- Every tree in a forest has depth at most `bound`. -/
   197	def ForestDepthLE (bound : ℕ) (forest : List (Tree α)) : Prop :=
   198	  ∀ tree ∈ forest, tree.depth ≤ bound
   199	
   200	theorem combineHalves_depth_le {left right : List (Tree α)} {bound : ℕ}
   201	    (hleft : ForestDepthLE bound left)
   202	    (hright : ForestDepthLE bound right) :
   203	    ForestDepthLE (bound + 1) (combineHalves left right) := by
   204	  induction left generalizing right with
   205	  | nil =>
   206	      cases right with
   207	      | nil => simp [ForestDepthLE, combineHalves]
   208	      | cons tree trees =>
   209	          intro candidate hcandidate
   210	          exact (hright candidate (by simpa [combineHalves] using hcandidate)).trans
   211	            (Nat.le_succ bound)
   212	  | cons tree trees ih =>
   213	      cases right with
   214	      | nil =>
   215	          intro candidate hcandidate
   216	          exact (hleft candidate (by simpa [combineHalves] using hcandidate)).trans
   217	            (Nat.le_succ bound)
   218	      | cons other others =>
   219	          have htree : tree.depth ≤ bound := hleft tree (by simp)
   220	          have hother : other.depth ≤ bound := hright other (by simp)
   221	          have htrees : ForestDepthLE bound trees := by
   222	            intro candidate hcandidate
   223	            exact hleft candidate (by simp [hcandidate])
   224	          have hothers : ForestDepthLE bound others := by
   225	            intro candidate hcandidate
   226	            exact hright candidate (by simp [hcandidate])
   227	          intro candidate hcandidate
   228	          simp only [combineHalves, List.mem_cons] at hcandidate
   229	          rcases hcandidate with rfl | hcandidate
   230	          · simp only [Tree.depth]
   231	            omega
   232	          · exact ih htrees hothers candidate hcandidate

   235	    (hdepth : ForestDepthLE bound forest) :
   236	    ForestDepthLE (bound + 1) (reductionRound forest) := by
   237	  apply combineHalves_depth_le
   238	  · intro tree htree

   244	    (hdepth : ForestDepthLE bound forest) (rounds : ℕ) :

     4	/-! # Floating-point binary-tree reduction -/
     5	
     6	namespace Research.BinaryTreeReduction
     7	
     8	open Research.FloatingPoint
     9	
    10	/-- Evaluate a tree using floating-point addition at every internal node. -/
    11	def roundedSum (model : Model) : Tree ℝ → ℝ
    12	  | .leaf value => value
    13	  | .node left right => model.add (roundedSum model left) (roundedSum model right)
    14	
    15	/-- `perturbed` has the same shape as `original`, and each perturbed leaf
    16	differs from its original value by at most `bound * |value|`. -/
    17	inductive IsPerturbation (bound : ℝ) : Tree ℝ → Tree ℝ → Prop where
    18	  | leaf (x y : ℝ) (error_le : |y - x| ≤ bound * |x|) :
    19	      IsPerturbation bound (.leaf x) (.leaf y)
    20	  | node {left left' right right' : Tree ℝ}
    21	      (left_ok : IsPerturbation bound left left')
    22	      (right_ok : IsPerturbation bound right right') :
    23	      IsPerturbation bound (.node left right) (.node left' right')
    24	
    25	namespace IsPerturbation
    26	
    27	/-- A leafwise perturbation remains valid when its nonnegative bound grows. -/
    28	theorem mono {original perturbed : Tree ℝ} {bound nextBound : ℝ}
    29	    (h : IsPerturbation bound original perturbed)
    30	    (hbound : bound ≤ nextBound) :
    31	    IsPerturbation nextBound original perturbed := by
    32	  induction h with
    33	  | leaf x y error_le =>
    34	      apply IsPerturbation.leaf
    35	      exact error_le.trans
    36	        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbound (abs_nonneg x))
    37	  | node left_ok right_ok ihLeft ihRight =>
    38	      exact IsPerturbation.node ihLeft ihRight
    39	
    40	/-- Compose two leafwise relative perturbations. -/
    41	theorem trans {original middle perturbed : Tree ℝ} {first second : ℝ}
    42	    (hFirst : IsPerturbation first original middle)
    43	    (hSecond : IsPerturbation second middle perturbed)
    44	    (hsecond_nonneg : 0 ≤ second) :
    45	    IsPerturbation (first + second * (1 + first)) original perturbed := by
    46	  induction hFirst generalizing perturbed with
    47	  | leaf x y first_error =>
    48	      cases hSecond with
    49	      | leaf _ z second_error =>
    50	          apply IsPerturbation.leaf
    51	          have hy : |y| ≤ (1 + first) * |x| := by
    52	            calc
    53	              |y| = |(y - x) + x| := by ring_nf
    54	              _ ≤ |y - x| + |x| := abs_add_le _ _
    55	              _ ≤ first * |x| + |x| := add_le_add first_error le_rfl
    56	              _ = (1 + first) * |x| := by ring
    57	          calc
    58	            |z - x| = |(z - y) + (y - x)| := by
    59	              congr 1
    60	              ring
    61	            _ ≤ |z - y| + |y - x| := abs_add_le _ _
    62	            _ ≤ second * |y| + first * |x| :=
    63	              add_le_add second_error first_error
    64	            _ ≤ second * ((1 + first) * |x|) + first * |x| := by
    65	              gcongr
    66	            _ = (first + second * (1 + first)) * |x| := by ring
    67	  | node left_ok right_ok ihLeft ihRight =>
    68	      cases hSecond with
    69	      | node secondLeft secondRight =>
    70	          exact IsPerturbation.node
    71	            (ihLeft secondLeft) (ihRight secondRight)
    72	
    73	/-- Multiplying every perturbed leaf by one more relative-error factor
    74	updates the leafwise error bound by `bound + u * (1 + bound)`. -/
